featured_reviews.name: Chaitali Shirodkar
featured_reviews.review_text:
We chose Bali as our honeymoon destination through travel caster and they didn’t disappoint us at all. We went there in Feb 2020 and stayed for 5 nights and 6 days at Park Regis Kuta. Its about 30-40mins away from the airport. The flight was amazing from Malaysia to denpasar.. Bali was hot like Mumbai but not as humid so it was comfortable to travel during the day. Most of the places are extremely clean with no litter on the roads. 4 wheelers observe traffic rules very seriously. The Balinese people are very polite and friendly. We never felt unsafe at any moment. Shopping is cheap too and street food is amazing. Would recommend this place for family as well.
Local sightseeing is plenty of things Tanah lot temple, beaches like Kuta beach, benoa beach, ubud rice terraces, nusa penida island much more. Kintamani, Barong Dance, Goa Gajah, Monkey Forest and Ubud and others serene places have a one of a kind experience when u visit these places. At benoa Beaches we tried water sports like snorkeling, sea walk, Jet Ski, Banana Boat ride, Parasailing other water sports.. Turtle Island.. And believe me every part of it was worth spending 😀 thanks to travel caster and their management we found our best honeymoon

featured_reviews.name: Roger Gonsalves
featured_reviews.review_text:
I traveled to Dubai with my family (wife, daughter, and son) through Angel Tours and Travels in October 2025, and we had an amazing experience! This was our 3rd tour with Angel Tours and Travels (after Vietnam and Japan), and we were thrilled to explore Dubai with them again. Our 5-day, 6-night stay at the Marco Polo hotel was fantastic. The hotel rooms were spacious and comfortable.

The tour package included delicious lunches and dinners at top-notch restaurants like Al Ibrahim, Lal Quila, and Peshwa - the food was superb! Breakfast at the hotel was also great.

Pranay, our tour manager, was extremely attentive and took great care of everyone in the family. He ensured everything ran smoothly and we had a hassle-free experience.

The office staff were very helpful in explaining the tour itinerary and clearing all our doubts before the tour began. They made sure we were well-prepared and excited for the trip.

We visited some incredible tourist spots, including the Burj Khalifa (124th floor), Miracle Garden, and Global Village. The Abu Dhabi city tour was a highlight, especially the visit to the Grand Mosque. And the cherry on top was getting a chance to attend a prayer at the Abrahamic Family House - a truly unique experience! The Desert Safari experience was thrilling and memorable.

A big thank you to Joyce mam for arranging such a wonderful tour! We wish Angel Tours and Travels all the best for their future endeavors.

Overall, I'd highly recommend Angel Tours and Travels for a well-organized and enjoyable Dubai trip. Kudos to Pranay and the team for making our trip so special!" 😊

featured_reviews.name: Kaushik Brahmbhatt
featured_reviews.review_text:

I have travelled worldwide individuals and with tour opretors as well. Angel is 1st tour opretors who is giving you breakfast, lunch and dinner in restaurant only. Not packed food.
Thanks a millions to Mrs. Joyce and her team  particularly Suvarna to take care of each and every individual passenger request for special arrangement. We were a single family who was vegetarian among a group of 24 in Turkey. They tried their lavel best and gave us pure vegetarian food.
Once you request them for any reasonable change, they are trying to give the same asap.
They are always giving you the better then they promised. They r promise for 4star hotels and they give you 5star. In cruise also they promise for 4star and gave us 5star. I mean to say that they are not giving you any inferior property to stay, always they give you superior property.
If we r making any plan for visiting any other country then Angel comes 1st in our mind to ask them.

I WISH THEM ALL THE BEST...

featured_reviews.name: Amit Belekar
featured_reviews.review_text:
Travmod is a genuine agency with transparent transaction and complete satisfaction of the customer. Recently we planned a travel for the group of 42 people to Royal carribbean cruise and Singapore land tour. Whole group requirements , visas, accommodation ,transfers, food etc... everything was handled very efficiently and professionally by Darshan Sharma (Travmod).

Costing for the tour quoted by travmod was unmatchably low yet services provided were very professional and good selection of hotels.
They focus more on customer satisfaction and creating an experiences for them than just planning a tour.
Darshan (Travmod) also helped us on the unfortunate medical emergency occured  on our tour until patient reached his home safely.

Every group member was issued with few thoughtful compliments/ gifts and complete travel kit ( passport cover, organizers sanitizer, bags, key chains , customised printed Tshirts for full group etc... )

I look forward and recommend booking through Travmod in future without a second thought.
